knowledge_used.how_applied: Design procedure steps 1-7 followed: quantities/ranges listed, element + isolator chosen per quantity (Hall for current, divider + AMC1311 for voltages), scaling at maximum operating and trip values, filters, isolated supply budgeted on the gate-bias module, hardware trip path to PWM trip, calibration planned.
Principle 1 (SELV control domain, every crossing a rated isolator) applied to all sensing; gate-driver FLT/RDY/RST-EN latched-fault interface used; DESAT itself left to the gate-driver agent.
Step 8: MMCX V_GS probe point at the device side of R_G per MOSFET; filtered single-ended segments at receiving pins; net-class spacing for sensing islands.
Bias power budget method used to quantify the 5V_ISO load (0.25 W typ / 0.35 W max) the gate-driver agent must add to the low-side module.

Principle 5 / procedure step 5: NTC placed where it represents the supervised quantity (heatsink between the devices) and routed through the driver's isolated analog channel; thresholds deferred to the thermal model.
DC-link capacitance is the capacitor agent's; only its value (assumed 60 uF) enters pre-charge and bleeder calculations.

Barrier parts rated for the node: TMCS1133 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC reinforced at a 200 V node; AMC1311 1500 Vrms at 480 V / 240 V nodes; relay 2500 VAC coil-contacts; UCC21710 barrier per gate-driver agent.
480 V -> 1.595 V (80 % of 2 V), 240 V -> 1.589 V (79 %), 37.5 A trip -> 2.205 V of 3.0 V; 2 V linear range mapped exactly to 3.0 V ADC so the chain cannot clip before the isolator does.
TMS320F28335 has no sigma-delta filter module; bitstream isolators (AMC1306/AMC1336) cannot be decoded; analog isolated chains with short routes used instead.
No shunt selected (Hall sensor); would apply to the rejected AMC1302 alternative.
Hardware OC path: TMCS1133 OC pin (100-250 ns) -> latch -> driver RST/EN and ePWM TZ1/TZ2; ADC loop shown to be too slow (output short ramps to trip in 4.4-7.3 us).

Inductor-path OC response computed (546 ns, 1.1 A overshoot); shoot-through/device short is invisible to the Hall sensor, so compliance depends on the gate-driver agent's DESAT response versus device withstand time - surfaced, not decided here.
Latched combined FAULT_N (SN74LVC1G74) with power-on/brown-out lock-out (TPS3808), UVLO as non-latched run-permit, explicit DSP reset, no auto-restart for OC/DESAT/OVP.
12 V auxiliary protection (CB-PR-001 eFuse pattern) recommended to the owner of the 12 V distribution with thresholds matched to the bias modules.
Shared insulated heatsink implies the NTC tag must also be insulated from the heatsink (M703 test voltage only ~150 V AC).

NTC reading treated as heatsink temperature for cooling supervision; OTP threshold (95 degC) flagged for confirmation against the thermal agent's junction model; feedback isolated through the driver APWM channel.
Sensing islands (GND1/5V_ISO, sensor HV pins) confined; no copper across the barrier on any layer.

8 mm package creepage of TMCS1133/AMC1311 compared with ~10 mm reinforced creepage at 480 V working voltage, PD2, material group IIIa; slot or CTI >= 400 laminate proposed - requires insulation-coordination review.
V_GS probe point at the device for each switch; probe-loop inductance minimised with MMCX.
Capacitor sizing belongs to the capacitor agent; its result changes tau of pre-charge and discharge (sensitivities given).

Hall-sensor block reused for the inductor-output path; TIDA instance values (45/70 A, 8.2k/1.2k divider, B1 variant) not copied; threshold derived from SBOSAG0E equation 21 with a precision reference, orderable number corrected to the A-suffix.
Record used and corrected: datasheet orderables are TMCS1133xxAQDVGR; TMCS1133B1QDVGR not listed; VIOWM 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC confirmed from the fetched datasheet.
800 V ladder (8 x 634 k) rescaled to 480 V (4 x 750 k + 10 k) and 240 V (2 x 750 k + 10 k); OPA2320 stage gain changed to 1.5 for the 0-3 V ADC; per-resistor stress recomputed.
AMC1311B used for both voltages; IDD1 7.1/9.7 mA, 2 V FSR, 2.516 V clipping, 1500 Vrms working voltage taken from SBAS786C.
Shunt + AMC1302 evaluated and rejected (no fast OC output, extra loss and HV supply); modulator variant impossible without SDFM.
Rejected alternative; parameters used only in the comparison table.

NTC via UCC21710 AIN/APWM; TDK M703 NTC instead of module NTC/TMP6131; bias network derived for 200 uA + 5V_ISO Thevenin source; transfer function and fail-safe states computed; potentiometer calibration kept.

AIN range 0.6-4.5 V, duty 88-10 %, I_AIN 200 uA, 400 kHz APWM, open-drain FLT/RDY/APWM, RST/EN >= 1000 ns reset, 130 ns propagation (SLUSDH8D) used for the temperature chain and the trip chain timing.
Low-side gate bias -> series resistor -> TLV76050 -> 5V_ISO for both AMC1311 and the NTC bias; current 16.9/23.1 mA and R_pre 270 ohm derived for +15 V (390 ohm for +18 V).
TPS26400 eFuse pattern recommended for the 12 V auxiliary input; thresholds to be matched to the chosen bias modules by the owner.
Recommendation only (not in this agent's BOM).
Decisions 6-8 (sensing split, LDO from gate bias, aux eFuse) reused as methods; all instance values re-derived for this converter.
Decision 3 (latched global fault, RESET/EN timing) and decision 8 (NTC through AIN/APWM, low-side reference, calibration) adapted to a discrete-FET buck; PRD-09301 section 3.4 and 5.1 cited.
No shunt; Hall conductor path needs copper sizing instead (PE-PCB-006).
Sensor placed in the DC output path, ladders and sense pairs routed away from the switch node.
TMCS1133 IN+/IN- pads and bypass-relay/PTC/fuse wiring sized for 27.5 A continuous.
Comparators, latch and conversion stage on the SELV control board; sensor LV sides grouped in a SELV area of the power board.
100 nF at TMCS1133 VS, AMC1311 VDD1/VDD2, TLV760 in/out, comparator and latch supplies.

selection.voltage_sensing: AMC1311BDWVR x2 with 4 x 750 k + 10.0 k (Vin, 602 V = 2 V = 3 V ADC) and 2 x 750 k + 10.0 k (Vout, 302 V full scale); 1 nF across the bottom resistor + 100 pF at IN; OPA2320 difference amplifiers gain 1.5 with 330 pF (32 kHz); 1 kohm + 1 nF to ADCINA0/A1.

selection.fuse: Littelfuse KLKD020.T, 20 A 600 VDC fast-acting midget in a 10 x 38 holder at the input terminal (I2t to be obtained).
selection.pre_charge_and_relay: TDK PTC B59773C0120A070 across Omron G9EA-1 DC12 (60 A / 400 VDC) bypass relay; close when V_bus > 340 V and dV/dt < 2 V/10 ms (500 ms timeout -> PRECHARGE_FAIL), open only >= 10 ms after PWM stop; coil 12 V 417 mA via low-side MOSFET + freewheel diode.
selection.dc_link_discharge: Input: 3 x 150 k (bleeder) || 2 x 220 k + LED (indicator) = 222 k, 480 -> 60 V in 27.8 s at 60 uF, 0.87 W at 440 V; output: 2 x 150 k, 240 -> 60 V in 16.6 s at 40 uF, 0.16 W; optional MOV S20K385 at the input.

calculations.name: Input current at design corners
calculations.expression: I_in = P / (eta x V_in)

calculations.name: Current sensor transfer and ADC codes
calculations.expression: V_OUT = V_0 + S x I_L ; code = V_OUT / (3.0 V / 4096)

calculations.name: OC threshold voltage and divider
calculations.result: V_OC = 0.750 V ; divider 0.7487 V loaded -> I_OC = 37.4 A ; band +-2 % typ 36.7-38.2 A ; +-10 % max 33.7-41.2 A ; hysteresis 3.5 A
calculations.knowledge_ref: SBOSAG0E eq. 21 and OC detection table; CB-SN-004 (adapted)

calculations.name: Hardware trip chain response
calculations.expression: t = t_OC,max + t_latch + t_RSTEN_deglitch,max + t_pd,driver,max + t_gate_fall

calculations.name: Current overshoot after trip and peak current
calculations.expression: dI = (V_in,max / L_min) x t ; I_pk = I_OC,max + dI
calculations.result: di/dt 2.0 A/us ; dI 1.09 A ; I_pk 39.3 A typical, 42.3 A worst ; seed saturation requirement 1.3 x 31.25 = 40.6 A -> worst corner exceeds it

calculations.name: Output-short ramp time to trip
calculations.expression: t = (I_OC - I_pk,nom) x L / V_in
calculations.result: 4.4 us to 7.3 us (< one 20 us period)

calculations.name: Input voltage ladder scaling
calculations.expression: k = R_b / (n R_t + R_b) ; V_ADC = 1.5 x k x V_bus

calculations.name: Input ladder per-resistor stress
calculations.expression: V_R = V_bus x R_t / (n R_t + R_b) ; P_R = V_R^2 / R_t ; I_div = V_bus / (n R_t + R_b)

calculations.name: Output voltage ladder scaling and stress
calculations.expression: k = R_b / (2 R_t + R_b) ; V_ADC = 1.5 k V_out ; V_R = V_out R_t / (2 R_t + R_b)

calculations.name: Sense-chain filter corners
calculations.expression: f_c = 1 / (2 pi R C)

calculations.name: 5V_ISO current and power budget
calculations.expression: I = 2 x I_DD1 + I_NTCnet + I_q,LDO ; P_15V = 15 V x I
calculations.result: 16.9 mA typ / 23.1 mA max ; 0.25 W typ / 0.35 W max from the low-side gate rail
calculations.knowledge_ref: CB-IS-002 bias power budget (EC-014 method); TIDA-010054 decision 7

calculations.name: Series resistor before the LDO
calculations.expression: R_pre <= (V_DD,min - V_LDO,in,min) / I_max ; P = I^2 R
calculations.result: <= 313 ohm -> 270 ohm 0.5 W ; drop 6.25 V ; 145 mW in R_pre, 87 mW in the LDO ; 390 ohm if V_DD = 18 V

calculations.name: AIN voltage with bias network
calculations.expression: V_AIN = (I_AIN + V_th / R_th) x ((R_s + R_NTC) || R_th) ; V_th = 5 V x 15 k / 19.75 k ; R_th = 4.75 k || 15 k
calculations.knowledge_ref: CB-PR-002 V_AIN = I_AIN x R (extended with external Thevenin bias); SLUSDH8D

calculations.name: Temperature resolution
calculations.expression: dV_T/dT (90-100 degC) ; K per eCAP count = (3.3 V / 375) / (dV_T/dT)
calculations.result: 8.6 mV/K ; 1.03 K per count ; 0.085 K per ADC LSB

calculations.name: Fuse loading
calculations.expression: load = I_in / I_fuse

calculations.name: Pre-charge energy, time, peak current, I2t
calculations.expression: E = 0.5 C V^2 ; tau = R C ; t_99 = 4.6 tau ; I_pk = V / R ; I2t = C V^2 / (2 R)

calculations.name: PTC thermal check
calculations.expression: dT = E / C_th ; N = K C V^2 / (2 C_th (T_ref - T_A,max))
calculations.result: dT 3.3 K per charge ; N = 0.047 -> 1 element (margin ~21x)
calculations.knowledge_ref: TDK PTC datasheet 'calculation of the number of required PTC elements'

calculations.name: Relay closing voltage difference
calculations.expression: dV = I_bleed x R_PTC

calculations.name: Input DC-link discharge
calculations.expression: tau = R_par C ; t_60 = tau ln(V_0 / 60 V) ; P = V^2 / R_par
calculations.result: tau 13.3 s ; 27.8 s from 480 V, 26.6 s from 440 V (46.3 s at 100 uF) ; 0.87 W at 440 V ; per resistor <= 160 V and 143 mW

calculations.name: Output discharge
calculations.expression: tau = R C ; t_60 = tau ln(V_0 / 60 V)

calculations.name: Comparator thresholds from 2.5 V
calculations.expression: V_th = 2.5 V x R_b / (R_t + R_b) ; V_bus = V_th / 4.9834e-3 ; V_out = V_th / 9.9338e-3

calculations.name: Sensor conductor and ADC clamp checks
calculations.expression: P = I^2 R_IN ; I_clamp = (V_src - V_DDA - 0.7) / R_s
calculations.result: 0.53 W in the TMCS1133 conductor ; clamp current < 0.3 mA (< 2 mA continuous limit)
calculations.knowledge_ref: SBOSAG0E R_IN; SPRS439Q absolute maximum note 3

pcb_constraints: TMCS1133: IN+/IN- conductor pads carry 27.5 A continuous (0.53 W): wide 70 um copper on both sides with via stitching, no thermal reliefs (PE-PCB-006); place in the inductor-to-output-capacitor path at least 10 mm from the inductor core and the switch node; keep other high-current traces from running parallel under the package.

TMCS1133 and AMC1311 barriers: package creepage/clearance 8 mm; at 480 V working voltage, PD2, CTI 175 (group IIIa) reinforced creepage is about 10 mm -> add a >= 1 mm wide slot under each isolator body or use CTI >= 400 laminate (KR-ISO-002, KR-ISO-004); the SELV area of the power board must keep the same distance from all HV copper; no copper on any layer across the barrier (KR-ISO-001).

HV ladders: 4 (input) and 2 (output) 1206 resistors in a straight line along the creepage path, >= 1.0 mm between bodies (120 V per element), ladder and AMC1311 HV pins >= 8 mm (or slot) from SELV copper, kept away from the switch node (PE-PCB-005); 1 nF C0G across the 10.0 k bottom resistor and 100 pF at IN placed at the pin; GND1 island returns to the low-side driver COM at one point.
AMC1311 OUTP/OUTN routed as differential pairs to the OPA2320 stage next to the ADC (control board); 100 nF decoupling at VDD1, VDD2 and TMCS1133 VS directly at the pins (PE-PCB-008).
5V_ISO island (TLV760, R_pre, decoupling) inside the low-side driver's isolated island; the NTC twisted pair and its 10 nF filter stay within that island (CB-PR-002).

NTC B57703M0103G040 lug under an M3 screw midway between the two TO-247-4 devices on the heatsink, with an insulating pad and insulated screw (test voltage of the probe is only ~150 V AC); leads twisted and strain-relieved.

Bleeder strings: 3 x 150 k and 2 x 220 k 1206 spaced >= 1.0 mm (<= 160 V per element), away from heat-sensitive parts (0.87 W total); DC-LINK LIVE LED at the board edge, visible with the cover on, with silkscreen discharge-time warning; output bleeder 2 x 150 k across the output capacitors.

Fuse in a 10 x 38 mm panel/DIN holder on the input lead before the board; PTC leaded disc mounted with >= 5 mm free space (reaches 130 degC on fault) directly across the relay contacts; Omron G9EA-1 chassis-mounted with >= 2.5 mm2 (14 AWG) wiring; coil wiring is SELV, contact wiring HV (2500 VAC coil-contact).

Fault latch, comparators, REF3125 and the wired-OR node on the control board close to the DSP; wired-OR node kept short with a single 4.7 k pull-up; 33 ohm series + 100 pF at TZ1/TZ2 inputs; FAULT_N to DRV_RST_EN routed as a single-ended trace with an RC at the driver input per the gate-driver agent.
Every ADC input through 1.0 kohm series + 1 nF at the pin (F28335 analog absolute maximum 3.0 V, internal clamp 2 mA); ADC traces away from PWM and TEMP_PWM (400 kHz).
SELV test points only in the SELV area; MMCX V_GS jacks at the device side of R_G on the driver island, referenced to the Kelvin source, labelled HV; no probe loops crossing the barrier.

Relay coil driver (low-side MOSFET, freewheel diode) on the SELV side with a 10 ms release delay after FAULT_N so the relay never opens under load; K1 status inferred from V_IN_SENSE (no auxiliary contact).
open_issues: Capacitor agent: DC-link capacitance assumed 60 uF (output 40 uF). Pre-charge time scales with C (25-41 ms at 60 uF), discharge time 27.8 s at 60 uF / 46 s at 100 uF; merge the bleeder strings proposed here with the capacitor agent's own bleeder assumption.

Magnetics agent: worst-case hardware trip corner 42.3 A (threshold +10 %, 1.1 A overshoot) exceeds the seed saturation margin of 40.6 A; either specify I_sat >= 45 A at operating temperature or lower I_OC to ~35 A (140 %).

Insulation coordination (KR-ISO-002, human review): 8 mm package creepage of TMCS1133/AMC1311 versus ~10 mm reinforced creepage at 480 V working voltage on CTI 175 laminate; options are a slot under each isolator (KR-ISO-004) or arguing a CTI >= 400 laminate seed change; clearance (5.5 mm reinforced for 4 kV impulse) is satisfied.

Fuse: KLKD020 melting I2t and time-current data not found (Littelfuse pages blocked) - obtain the datasheet; with a current-limited laboratory source a bolted fault may never clear the fuse, so the source limit must be <= 20 A and the OC/UVLO logic is the effective protection; selective coordination with the upstream bus protection to be checked.

Relay: G9EA-1 coil is ~5 W (0.42 A of the 2 A auxiliary budget); a PWM hold at ~60 % is suggested; the 1.2 W G9EJ-1-E is acceptable only if Omron confirms a carry current >= 16 A (datasheet access returned HTTP 403).

OTP threshold 95 degC heatsink is an assumption; thermal agent to confirm against the junction model (KR-TH-003); calibrate the NTC channel with a potentiometer (CB-PR-002); eCAP resolution is ~1 K per count, finer via the RC-filtered ADC path.

NTC insulation: the M703 probe's ~150 V AC test voltage requires an insulating pad/washer to a PE-bonded heatsink; the architecture agent must state the PGND-to-heatsink/PE potential (floating source case).

Gate-driver agent: budget 0.25 W typ / 0.35 W max for 5V_ISO on the low-side bias module; state the VDD value (R_pre 270 ohm for 15 V, 390 ohm for 18 V); provide FLT/RDY/RST-EN pins per section 1; DESAT total response versus device withstand time (KR-PR-001, KR-GD-004) is not covered by the Hall sensor.
UVLO comparator: the open-collector hysteresis network (1.00 k / 1.91 k + 21.5 k) gives ~320/340 V nominally but is asymmetric; verify by simulation or implement bus UVLO in firmware only.

Knowledge maintenance: CMP-TMCS1133 orderable_variants should be corrected from TMCS1133B1QDVGR to the A-suffixed numbers listed in SBOSAG0E; the TI product page quotes VIOWM 600 Vrms while the datasheet states 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC reinforced.

Procurement: TMCS1133C2AQDVGR has a 12-week manufacturer lead time at Digi-Key (as for B1AQDVGR); the TLV760 maximum quiescent current, the ladder resistor limiting voltage, the LED/MMCX/test-point part numbers and the MOV clamping voltage remain unverified.
Output OVP at 220 V leaves 10 V above the allowed +5 % transient excursion (210 V); review against load-dump behaviour before fixing the value.
12 V auxiliary input protection (CB-PR-001 eFuse, KR-PR-003) has no owner yet; recommended to the architecture/gate-driver agent.

Firmware/hardware contract items to document: TZ1 one-shot on FAULT_N, TZ2 one-shot on I_OC_N, ADC SOC at PWM mid-point, 110 % overload timer (10 s), pre-charge closing criterion and timeout, restart policy, open-sensor detection (TEMP duty < 15 %).
verification_status: Design calculations complete at all design-basis corners (360/400/440/460/480 V, 25/27.5 A, overload peaks, 50 degC). Key parameters verified from fetched datasheets for TMCS1133 (SBOSAG0E rev. May 2026), AMC1311 (SBAS786C), UCC21710-Q1 (SLUSDH8D), TLV1702, REF3125, SN74LVC1G74, TMS320F28335 ADC limits, TDK M703 NTC, TDK PTC inrush limiters, TDK SIOV S20K385 and Omron G9EA-1 (J186-E1-01); OPA2320 and TLV760 at manufacturer-page level; KLKD020.T and G9EJ-1-E at search-snippet level (KLKD I2t and G9EJ carry current not found); ladder resistors, LED, MMCX/test points, MOV clamping voltage and TLV760 Iq max unverified. Human review required for isolator creepage at 480 V on CTI 175 material, inductor saturation versus the worst-case trip corner, the OTP threshold, DESAT coordination, fuse I2t/clearing with a current-limited source, relay choice and NTC insulation. No repository file other than this result was created.

# Sensing, protection and power-path auxiliaries (400 V -> 200 V, 5 kW, 50 kHz SiC synchronous buck)

## 1. Scope, basis and gate-driver interface

This section covers inductor/output current sensing with a fast hardware overcurrent (OC) trip, isolated input and output voltage sensing, heatsink temperature supervision, the 400 V input power path (fuse, pre-charge, bypass relay, DC-link discharge, surge), UVLO/OVP thresholds, the fault-latch architecture, safe test interfaces and the signal list handed to the interconnect agent. Device-level short-circuit protection (DESAT) is owned by the gate-driver agent; the interface expected here is a UCC21710-class driver with open-drain FLT (latched, parallelable), open-drain RDY (VCC/VDD power-good) and a 3.3 V RST/EN input that disables the output and clears FLT when held low >= 1000 ns, with 130 ns maximum input-to-output propagation (SLUSDH8D; CB-GD-001; KR-PR-001). The DESAT trip level and blanking remain a human-review item (KR-GD-004).

Design-basis inputs used: Vin 360/400/440 V, UVLO 340/320 V, OVP 460 V, survival 480 V; Vout 200 V, output OVP ~220 V; Iout 25 A, 110 % overload 27.5 A, ripple 7.5 App (peaks 28.75 A nominal, 31.25 A at overload), L 220-300 uH; 12 V/2 A SELV auxiliary; 3 V / 12-bit ADC. Added assumptions are listed in section 9 and in `assumptions_added`.

## 2. Current sensing and fast overcurrent trip (SKILL-005 steps 1-3, 6)

### 2.1 Option comparison

| Option | Barrier | Fast OC path | HV-side supply | Dissipation at 27.5 A | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hall sensor TMCS1133 in the inductor-output (200 V DC) path | Reinforced, VIOWM 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC, 8 mm package creepage (SBOSAG0E) | Built-in comparator, 100 ns typ / 250 ns max, open-drain OC pin | None (powered from the SELV side) | 27.5^2 x 0.7 mohm = 0.53 W in the integrated conductor | Selected |
| Shunt + AMC1302 isolated amplifier (CB-SN-003 amplifier variant) | Reinforced 1.5 kVrms | None built in; needs a SELV comparator after the amplifier | 5V_ISO needed, plus Kelvin pair and filter (KR-SN-004, PE-PCB-004) | 1.0 mohm shunt (37.5 mV at trip): 0.76 W, 3 W part | Rejected: slower, more parts, shunt loss |
| Shunt + AMC1306/AMC1336 bitstream (CB-SN-002/-003 modulator variants) | Reinforced | - | - | - | Not usable: TMS320F28335 has no sigma-delta filter module, so KR-SN-003 (digital bitstream for long paths) is **not applicable** |
| Non-isolated low-side shunt amplifier referenced to PGND (V1 INA240 pattern) | None | Comparator possible | - | - | Rejected: PGND is part of the hazardous 400 V stage; every crossing must be a rated isolator (KR-SN-001, SKILL-001 principle 1) |

### 2.2 Device, orderable number and variant (discrepancy resolved)

The current datasheet SBOSAG0E (October 2023, revised May 2026, fetched) lists the orderables TMCS1133A1A..A5AQDVGR, TMCS1133B1A..B5A/B7A/B8AQDVGR and TMCS1133C1A..C4AQDVGR. The number TMCS1133B1QDVGR carried in the TIDA-010054 BOM (CMP-TMCS1133, CB-SN-004) is **not** a listed orderable; Digi-Key lists TMCS1133B1AQDVGR as orderable (not normally stocked, 12-week lead time). The "A"-suffixed numbers are therefore the valid ones and the knowledge record should be corrected. Reinforced working voltage per the datasheet is 950 Vrms / 1343 VDC (TI's product page states 600 Vrms, the TIDA guide 1100 VDC); our node is 200 V DC, so every stated value is adequate (KR-SN-001).

Selected variant: **TMCS1133C2AQDVGR** - unidirectional family (zero-current output 0.33 V), 50 mV/A, operated from 3.3 V. The datasheet states a -5 A to 57 A linear range for the C2A at 3.3 V, which covers the no-load ripple valley (-3.75 A) and the whole trip region while the output can never exceed the 3.3 V supply (F28335 ADC absolute maximum 3.0 V with internal clamps, SPRS439Q). The bidirectional B1AQDVGR (1.65 V, 25 mV/A) would halve the resolution; the 5 V "A" variants would need an output divider.

### 2.3 Scaling to the 0-3 V ADC (KR-SN-002)

V_OUT = 0.33 V + 0.050 V/A x I_L; LSB = 3.0 V / 4096 = 0.7324 mV = 14.65 mA; full scale 3.0 V = 53.4 A.

| I_L | 0 A | 25 A | 27.5 A (110 % warn) | 28.75 A (nominal peak) | 31.25 A (overload peak) | 37.5 A (150 % trip) | 40 A |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V_OUT | 0.330 V | 1.580 V | 1.705 V | 1.768 V | 1.893 V | 2.205 V | 2.330 V |
| ADC code | 450 | 2157 | 2327 | 2413 | 2583 | 3010 | 3181 |

The 110 % overload warning is a firmware threshold on the mid-period (average) sample: code 2327, 10 s timer, then controlled shutdown. Output filter 1.0 kohm + 1 nF (160 kHz) at the ADC pin; the ADC start-of-conversion is placed at the PWM counter mid-point so the 50 kHz ripple is sampled at its average.

### 2.4 Hardware trip threshold (CB-SN-004 adapted; TIDA values not copied)

Datasheet equation 21: V_OC = S x I_OC / 2.5. For I_OC = 37.5 A (150 %): V_OC = 0.050 x 37.5 / 2.5 = 0.750 V (allowed 0.3 V to VS). Divider from the REF3125 2.5 V reference: 2.32 kohm / 1.00 kohm (0.1 %); loaded by the 120 kohm pin impedance the voltage is 0.7487 V, i.e. I_OC = 37.4 A. Threshold error +-2 % typical / +-10 % maximum over -40..125 degC gives a trip band of 36.7-38.2 A typical, 33.7-41.2 A worst case; hysteresis 3.5 A (x2A option). The lower worst-case bound (33.7 A) stays 2.5 A above the 110 % overload peak (31.25 A).

### 2.5 Trip chain and timing (KR-SN-005, KR-PR-001)

OC_N (open-drain, 1.0 kohm pull-up to 3.3 V) -> wired-OR fault node -> SN74LVC1G74 asynchronous /CLR (5.9 ns max) -> FAULT_N -> (a) DRV_RST_EN low (UCC21710 deglitch 60 ns max + 130 ns max propagation) and (b) ePWM TZ1 one-shot. OC_N is additionally wired to TZ2 (one-shot) so the DSP trips without waiting for the latch. Total hardware response including an assumed 100 ns gate fall: 250 + 6 + 60 + 130 + 100 = 546 ns. With di/dt_max = Vin_max / L_min = 440 V / 220 uH = 2.0 A/us the current overshoot is 1.1 A: peak 39.3 A typical, 42.3 A at the +10 % threshold corner. The seed inductor saturation margin (>= 1.3 x 31.25 A = 40.6 A) does not cover the worst-case corner - see open issues. An output short ramps the current from 28.75 A to 37.5 A in 4.4 us (440 V, 220 uH) to 7.3 us (360 V, 300 uH), i.e. inside one 20 us switching period, which is why an ADC-based loop cannot be the protection (KR-SN-005). Shoot-through current bypasses the inductor and is invisible to this sensor; it is covered only by the gate-driver DESAT (interface in section 1).

## 3. Input and output voltage sensing (CB-SN-001 adapted; SKILL-005 principle 6)

### 3.1 Ladders (0.1 %, 1206 thin film, 200 V limiting element voltage)

Input: 4 x 750 kohm + 10.0 kohm (3.01 Mohm), ratio 3.3223e-3. Output: 2 x 750 kohm + 10.0 kohm (1.51 Mohm), ratio 6.6225e-3. V_R = V x R_top / R_total, P = V_R^2 / R_top.

| Node | Voltage | AMC1311 input | ADC (gain 1.5) | ADC code | Per-resistor V / P | Divider current |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vin | 320 V (UVLO off) | 1.063 V | 1.595 V | 2177 | 79.7 V / 8.5 mW | 106 uA |
| Vin | 340 V (UVLO on) | 1.130 V | 1.694 V | 2313 | 84.7 V / 9.6 mW | 113 uA |
| Vin | 360 V | 1.196 V | 1.794 V | 2449 | 89.7 V / 10.7 mW | 120 uA |
| Vin | 400 V | 1.329 V | 1.993 V | 2721 | 99.7 V / 13.2 mW | 133 uA |
| Vin | 440 V | 1.462 V | 2.193 V | 2993 | 109.6 V / 16.0 mW | 146 uA |
| Vin | 460 V (OVP) | 1.528 V | 2.292 V | 3129 | 114.6 V / 17.5 mW | 153 uA |
| Vin | 480 V (survival) | 1.595 V | 2.392 V | 3265 | 119.6 V / 19.1 mW | 159 uA |
| Vout | 200 V | 1.325 V | 1.987 V | 2712 | 99.3 V / 13.2 mW | 132 uA |
| Vout | 220 V (OVP) | 1.457 V | 2.185 V | 2983 | 109.3 V / 15.9 mW | 146 uA |
| Vout | 240 V (max measured) | 1.589 V | 2.384 V | 3255 | 119.2 V / 18.9 mW | 159 uA |

Headroom (KR-SN-002): 480 V uses 80 % of the 2 V linear range (2 V = 602 V); 240 V uses 79 % (2 V = 302 V). Resolution: 0.147 V/LSB input, 73.7 mV/LSB output. The AMC1311B (SBAS786C, fetched) has a 2 V specified linear range, 2.516 V clipping, gain 1, +-0.2 % gain error (B grade), 1500 Vrms working voltage, IDD1 7.1 mA typ / 9.7 mA max. Input filtering per datasheet section 9.2.2.1: 1 nF C0G across the 10.0 kohm bottom resistor (16 kHz with the 9.97 kohm Thevenin source) plus 100 pF directly at IN (datasheet application figure).

### 3.2 SELV-side conversion

OPA2320 (20 MHz, 150 uV offset, rail-to-rail, 1.8-5.5 V; manufacturer page) as a difference amplifier with 10.0 kohm / 15.0 kohm 0.1 % (gain 1.5) referenced to AGND; 330 pF across the feedback resistors (32 kHz); 1.0 kohm series + 1 nF into ADCINA0/ADCINA1. Because the 2 V linear range maps exactly onto 3.0 V, the chain cannot overdrive the ADC until the AMC1311 itself clips (then the op-amp saturates at 3.3 V and the mandatory 1 kohm series resistor limits the F28335 internal clamp current to < 0.3 mA, well below the 2 mA continuous rating). TLV9004 (cached datasheet, 1 MHz, 0.4 mV) is an acceptable lower-cost alternative.

### 3.3 HV-side 5 V supply (TIDA-010054 decision 7; CB-IS-002; SKILL-004 budget)

TLV76050DBZR (4.2-30 V in, 5 V, 100 mA, 1.2 V max dropout, 2 mA Iq; manufacturer page) fed from the low-side gate-driver VDD rail through R_pre. Load: 2 x AMC1311 IDD1 (14.2 mA typ / 19.4 mA max) + NTC bias network 0.74 mA + LDO Iq 2-3 mA = **16.9 mA typical / 23.1 mA maximum**, i.e. 0.25 W typ / 0.35 W max drawn from the +15 V rail (assumed VDD = +15 V +-5 %). R_pre <= (14.25 - 7.0 V) / 23.1 mA = 313 ohm -> 270 ohm, 0.5 W (145 mW dissipated, 87 mW in the LDO). If the gate-driver agent selects +18 V, R_pre = 390 ohm. Both AMC1311 GND1 pins and both ladder bottoms return to the low-side driver COM (Kelvin source) at one point; the shared supply is permitted because both sensors are referenced to the same node (CB-IS-002 interface requirement).

## 4. Heatsink temperature (CB-PR-002 adapted; KR-TH-003; SKILL-006 principle 5)

Sensor: TDK **B57703M0103G040** (10 kohm +-2 %, B25/100 = 3988 K +-1 %, R/T curve 8016, metal-tag encapsulation, PTFE AWG30 leads 500 mm; TDK M703 datasheet, fetched) screwed to the heatsink midway between the two TO-247-4 devices. Its test voltage is only ~150 V AC, so the tag is mounted on a rated insulating pad with an insulated screw: the leads are referenced to the low-side driver COM (~PGND) while the heatsink is chassis/PE (KR-TH-002).

Read-out through the low-side UCC21710 AIN/APWM channel (reference on the stable low-side node, PRD-09301 section 3.4): I_AIN = 200 uA (196-209 uA), V_AIN range 0.6-4.5 V maps to duty 88 % -> 10 % (D = 0.88 - 0.2 x (V_AIN - 0.6)), 400 kHz, open-drain APWM. A bias network from 5V_ISO (4.75 kohm to 5 V, 15.0 kohm to COM; Thevenin 3.80 V / 3.61 kohm) plus a 1.00 kohm series resistor and 10 nF at AIN raises the sensitivity three-fold compared with the 200 uA source alone and keeps the open-sensor voltage at 4.52 V (inside the pin range): V_AIN = 1.2526 mA x ((1.00 kohm + R_NTC) || 3.61 kohm).

| T_hs | 25 degC | 50 degC | 70 degC | 85 degC (warn) | 95 degC (OTP) | 100 degC | 110 degC | open NTC | shorted NTC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R_NTC | 10.0 k | 3.55 k | 1.73 k | 1.06 k | 786 | 680 | 514 | inf | 0 |
| V_AIN | 3.40 V | 2.52 V | 1.95 V | 1.64 V | 1.50 V | 1.44 V | 1.34 V | 4.52 V | 0.98 V |
| Duty | 31.9 % | 49.6 % | 61.1 % | 67.1 % | 70.1 % | 71.3 % | 73.3 % | 10 % | 80.4 % |
| V_T = 3.3 V x D (RC filtered) | 1.05 V | 1.64 V | 2.02 V | 2.22 V | 2.31 V | 2.35 V | 2.42 V | 0.33 V | 2.65 V |

Sensitivity 8.6 mV/K of V_T around 95 degC: 1.0 K per eCAP count (150 MHz / 400 kHz = 375 counts) or 0.09 K per ADC LSB. Open sensor reads 10 % duty (flag "sensor open" below 15 %), a shorted sensor or a driver UVLO (APWM floats high) trips OTP - fail-safe. OTP comparator threshold 2.313 V (1.00 kohm / 12.4 kohm from 2.5 V) = 95 degC heatsink; warning at 85 degC in firmware; restart hysteresis 15 K. The 95 degC value is an assumption pending the thermal agent's junction model (KR-TH-003: NTC is heatsink, not junction temperature); calibrate with a potentiometer in place of the NTC (CB-PR-002).

## 5. Input power path and protection

### 5.1 Fuse

I_in = P / (eta x Vin) = 5000 / (0.98 x 360) = 14.2 A at 360 V (12.8 A at 400 V); 110 % overload 15.6 A for 10 s. Selected **Littelfuse KLKD020.T** (10 x 38 mm midget, 20 A, 600 VAC/VDC, fast-acting; DC interrupting 10 kA per UL 248-19 and 50 kA per UL 248-14; search-snippet level): continuous loading 71 %, overload 78 %. Melting I2t was **not found** (Littelfuse pages blocked); coordination so far: pre-charge I2t = C V^2 / (2 R) = 60 uF x 480^2 / (2 x 90 ohm) = 0.08 A2s (negligible), 10 s at 78 % does not melt. The fuse protects wiring and the source side against a failed-short device; it cannot protect SiC devices (DESAT does). With a current-limited laboratory source the fuse may never clear, so the source current limit (<= 20 A) and the OC/UVLO logic are the effective protection in that case. Alternative: Eaton Bussmann PV-20A10F (1000 VDC gPV, unverified).

### 5.2 Pre-charge: PTC inrush limiter instead of resistor + second relay

Inrush energy per charge E = 0.5 C V^2 = 5.8 J at 440 V, 6.9 J at 480 V (C_in = 60 uF assumed). Selected TDK **B59773C0120A070** PTC (Vmax 560 V, Vlink,max 800 V DC, R25 120 ohm +-25 %, Tref 130 degC, Cth 2.1 J/K; TDK inrush-limiter datasheet, fetched) permanently across the bypass relay contacts. Charging: tau = R C = 7.2 ms (5.4-9.0 ms), 99 % in 25-41 ms, peak 3.7 A at 440 V (5.3 A worst), temperature rise per charge 6.9 J / 2.1 J/K = 3.3 K, TDK parallel-count check N = C V^2 / (2 Cth (Tref - TA,max)) = 0.05 -> one element. TDK states the parts are not damaged when connected directly to Vmax, so a shorted DC link or a relay that fails to close leaves the PTC in its high-resistance state at a few watts: no second relay and no supervisory cut-off are required. Relay closing criterion (firmware): V_bus > 340 V and |dV_bus/dt| < 2 V per 10 ms -> contact voltage difference ~1 mA x 120 ohm = 0.12 V (zero-voltage closing); 500 ms timeout -> latched PRECHARGE_FAIL.

### 5.3 Bypass relay

Selected **Omron G9EA-1 DC12** (Omron Cat. No. J186-E1-01, fetched): rated load 60 A at 400 VDC, rated carry current 60 A, maximum switching voltage 400 V, electrical endurance 400 VDC / 60 A 3000 operations, 2500 VAC coil-to-contacts, coil 12 VDC 417 mA / 28.8 ohm (~5 W). The relay is sequenced so that it never makes or breaks load current (closes at ~0.1 V difference, opens only >= 10 ms after PWM stop when the input current is the ~2 mA bleeder current); its 400 VDC / 60 A rating still allows breaking the 14-16 A load in abnormal cases. The coil takes 0.42 A of the 2 A auxiliary budget; a PWM hold at ~60 % after 100 ms (2 W) is optional. Alternative Omron G9EJ-1-E DC12 (400 V / 15 A DC, 1.2 W coil) is acceptable only if Omron confirms a carry current >= 16 A (datasheet access blocked; not found).

### 5.4 DC-link discharge and indicator

Input: bleeder string 3 x 150 kohm 1206 (160 V and 143 mW per resistor at 480 V) in parallel with an indicator string 2 x 220 kohm + red low-current LED: 222 kohm total, tau = 13.3 s, 480 V -> 60 V in 27.8 s (46 s if the capacitor agent chooses 100 uF), 0.87 W at 440 V (0.017 % of rated power). The LED carries ~1 mA and extinguishes near 25-30 V; it is a warning, not proof of a safe voltage. Output: 2 x 150 kohm (300 kohm) across the output capacitors (40 uF assumed): 240 V -> 60 V in 16.6 s, 0.16 W. Bleeder values must be merged with the capacitor agent's assumption.

### 5.5 Surge

TDK SIOV **S20K385** (B72210S0381K101; 385 Vrms / 505 VDC, 8 kA 8/20 us, 1 W; TDK leaded SIOV datasheet, fetched) across the input downstream of the fuse. For a regulated laboratory source it is optional; it is included because the input cable and relay switching can ring. Its clamping voltage (~1.0 kV at 100 A per a distributor listing, unverified) is below the 1200 V SiC rating; 480 V / 100 ms is below its 505 VDC rating.

### 5.6 UVLO / OVP comparators

TLV1702 (dual open-collector comparator, 560 ns, 300 uV offset, 2.2-36 V; datasheet fetched) with REF3125 (2.5 V, 0.2 %, cached SBVS046E) and 0.1 % dividers on the SELV sense outputs: input OVP 1.00 kohm / 11.0 kohm = 2.2917 V = 459.9 V; output OVP 1.30 kohm / 9.09 kohm = 2.1872 V = 220.2 V; bus UVLO 1.00 kohm / 1.91 kohm = 1.641 V centre with a 21.5 kohm hysteresis resistor from the 3.3 V pulled-up output (+-0.05 V = +-10 V -> ~320 V off / ~340 V on; verify by simulation because the open-collector hysteresis is asymmetric); OTP 1.00 kohm / 12.4 kohm = 2.313 V. UVLO is a non-latched run-permit (PWM enable = ARM latch AND RDY AND NOT UVLO); the OVPs and OTP feed the fault latch.

### 5.7 Fault architecture and restart policy (KR-PR-002; CGD1700HB2M-UNA decision 3)

Wired-OR active-low fault node (4.7 kohm to 3.3 V): I_OC_N (TMCS1133), DRV_FLT_N (both UCC21710, paralleled), OVP_IN_N, OVP_OUT_N, OTP_N (TLV1702), POR_N (TPS3808G33 supervisor - holds the fault during power-up and 3.3 V brown-out) and SW_FAULT_N (DSP open-drain GPIO). Latch: SN74LVC1G74 (D = 1, /PRE = 1, /CLR = fault node, CLK = FAULT_RESET from the DSP): Q = FAULT_N falls within 5.9 ns and stays low after the source releases until the DSP clocks a reset, which only succeeds when every source is inactive. FAULT_N drives TZ1 (GPIO12, one-shot), the driver RST/EN line (through an AND with the DSP DRV_EN output so firmware can also disable), a red fault LED and a DSP status input; I_OC_N also drives TZ2. Restart policy: OC, driver FLT/DESAT, OVP_in, OVP_out and PRECHARGE_FAIL are latched and cleared only by an operator command after the DSP has checked that all sources are inactive, followed by a soft start - no automatic retry; OTP may auto-restart once the heatsink has cooled 15 K below the threshold (configurable); bus UVLO is not latched and restarts with soft start 100 ms after V_bus > 340 V. Each fault source is also readable on a DSP GPIO for diagnostics. The 12 V auxiliary input should carry the eFuse protection of CB-PR-001 (TPS26400: OVP, UVLO, current limit; KR-PR-003) - owner: architecture/gate-driver agent.

## 6. Safe test interfaces (SKILL-002 step 8; KR-PCB-005)

SELV-only test points (Keystone 5015 class) on the control board: I_L_SENSE, V_IN_SENSE, V_OUT_SENSE, TEMP_PWM and its filtered V_T, FAULT_N, I_OC_N, DRV_FLT_N, DRV_RDY, PWM_H/L, 3.3 V, 5 V, AGND. V_GS probe points: one MMCX jack per MOSFET at the device side of R_G referenced to the Kelvin source on the driver island (the high-side point floats at the switch node - silkscreen "HV - isolated/differential probe only"; no SELV test point may be placed inside the HV area). DC-link "LIVE" LED (section 5.4) visible at the board edge, plus a silkscreen discharge-time note.

## 7. Signal list: power stage -> controller (for the interconnect agent)

| Name | Type | Range / levels | Bandwidth or timing | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I_L_SENSE | Isolated analog (barrier inside sensor) | 0.08-3.3 V, 50 mV/A, 0.33 V at 0 A | 1 MHz sensor, filtered 160 kHz | TMCS1133C2A VOUT |
| I_OC_N | Isolated digital, open-drain active low | 3.3 V pull-up | 100-250 ns response | TMCS1133 OC |
| VIN_SNS_P / VIN_SNS_N | Isolated analog differential pair | 0-2 V differential on 1.44 V common mode | ~220 kHz, filtered 16 kHz | AMC1311B (Vin) |
| VOUT_SNS_P / VOUT_SNS_N | Isolated analog differential pair | 0-2 V differential on 1.44 V common mode | ~220 kHz, filtered 16 kHz | AMC1311B (Vout) |
| TEMP_PWM | Isolated digital PWM, open-drain | 400 kHz, 10-88 % duty | AIN bandwidth ~10 kHz | UCC21710 APWM (low side) |
| DRV_FLT_N, DRV_RDY, DRV_RST_EN, PWM_H, PWM_L | Driver primary-side logic | 3.3 V | per gate-driver agent | UCC21710 x2 |
| K1_COIL | SELV 12 V coil drive (low-side MOSFET + freewheel diode) | 417 mA | - | relay coil |
| FAULT_N, FAULT_RESET, ARM, DRV_EN, status GPIOs | SELV logic on the control board | 3.3 V | - | latch / DSP |

If the architecture agent places the sensor ICs on the power board, all signals above are SELV at the inter-board connector and the only barrier crossings are inside the rated components (TMCS1133, AMC1311, UCC21710, relay); the SELV area of the power board then needs the same creepage to the HV area as the component packages (section 8). If a separate driver board is chosen, TEMP_PWM and the driver logic signals move to that board's connector unchanged.

## 8. PCB constraints

See `pcb_constraints`; the critical ones are: 8 mm package creepage of TMCS1133/AMC1311 versus ~10 mm reinforced creepage required at 480 V working voltage on CTI 175 (material group IIIa) laminate, pollution degree 2 (KR-ISO-002) - resolve with a slot under each isolator (KR-ISO-004) or a CTI >= 400 laminate; no copper across any barrier (KR-ISO-001); the TMCS1133 conductor pads carry 27.5 A continuously (PE-PCB-006); ladders laid out along the creepage path and away from the switch node (PE-PCB-005); decoupling at every sensor IC pin (PE-PCB-008).
